messages:
Aria Gomez: hey team :wave: first day here — I just tried to open the Redwood Console (staging) -> Feature Flags and got a 403. Need to flip a flag for a customer demo in ~2h, who can give a temporary admin role?
Priya Singh: welcome Aria! :tada: pinging @AccessBot is fastest, but also cc me and your manager so we have approvals on record. what's your console username?
Aria Gomez: thanks Priya — aria.gomez@redwood.com. error snippet: `{"error":"403","reason":"missing role: flag_admin"}`
Sam Walker: I can grant a short staging-only role. Aria — confirm this is staging only and you need it for ~2 hours?
Aria Gomez: yes staging only, 2 hours. demo is at 11:30 PT.
AccessBot: Request received (REQ-4521). Auto-check: user exists, no conflicting roles. Sent approval request to Priya Singh and Jordan Lee.
Jordan Lee: noted — will approve for staging only. We'll capture the change in the audit log.
Priya Singh: approving now.
Sam Walker: done — granted `FF Admin (staging)` role to aria.gomez@redwood.com for 2 hours. Please verify. :thumbsup:
Aria Gomez: verified — I can see the Feature Flags list and toggle the demo flag. thank you!! :relieved:
Aria Gomez: quick follow-up — how do I find the flag owner after the demo so I can request longer-term changes?
Sam Walker: open the flag detail in Console -> Owner field, or use the internal CLI: `rfctl flags describe <flag-name> --env staging`
Sam Walker: if owner is unclear ping #feature-flags and include the flag id.
Priya Singh: added a note to your onboarding checklist about this flow and who to contact. welcome aboard again! :confetti_ball:
